contracts.resources: Explicit ResourceBundle immutable model values, sha receipts, image bytes32MiB/bundle128MiB/decode64Mpx. Native Image+FontLibrary register/cache only owner session; no native references leave session. URL names only lookup keys; data:image;base64 and sanitized inlineSVG are explicit offline bytes. Missing image error, source missing Iconify fallback question80x80. No automatic URL/path lookup from labels.
contracts.SVG: Safe static SVG native Image decode; complete fixed safe SVG tag/attr allowlists and XML case restoration. Script/events/foreignObject/animatedresource/externalhref/nonlocalurl references explicitly rejected. Root-body SVG in HTML labels serialized as offline image bytes; no DOM runtime.
contracts.fonts: Caller explicitly names alias/file. Validate file SHA then register on caller owner; never reset other user registrations. a18 italic numeric400/700 workaround retained. Real font/spacing state shared for measure/draw; expected face availability is S3/S4 matter.
contracts.export: Public toBufferSync png/jpg/jpeg-alias/webp/svg/pdf with quality,density,matte,outline,downsample. Raster results actual scaled pixels; vector logical page dimensions. Formats/MIME/errors explicit; no alternative renderer, SVGDOM host or productionJS.
contracts.resourceGeometry: Pure resources.geometry.asset_layout/resource_geometry shared by node measurement and asset placement. Source image naturalratio/constraint/w/h/pos and icon48/framepad/circle?2+40/labelgap8. Resource label2px padding and edgeLabelBackground real paint (HTML p opaque; SVG rectalpha.5). Virtual outer resource bbox is not painted. icon frame stroke semantic fill; icon SVGcurrentColor uses independent nodeBorder paint.
contracts.inlineAssets: HTML img and inlineSVG block image source geometry (image-only sitefontsize?5, mixed wrappingwidth). Iconify/FontAwesome class names resolve explicit IconResource IDs. Color/opacity/tagstyle honored, asset metrics/runs pure values; ownerImage decoded before actual measure. Direct SVG is a distinct intrinsic-size kind; host CSS applies via pure XML paint projection. Image/dataURI remains document-isolated.
contracts.handDrawn: Pure seeded Random math.imul-equivalent modulo32, seed0 source random, double-stroke cubic and source offset formulas, cubic jitter, endpoint arc conversion and scanline hachure at fixed source defaults. Generated pure paths reused for bounds and paint, including parts/details/frame/group/edge; doublecircle special .2roughness/2.5outer/1.5inner. Filled hachure strokes1.5. No raster image distortion. Source solidFillPolygon override now explicit, with native filled closed paths. Scanline stepping matches fixed hachure-fill source.
contracts.edgePaint: B-owned final path/paint_points/paint_bounds consumed directly; marker provider point/circle/cross/none and source userSpaceOnUse stroke widths. Circle fill theme lineColor retains custom edge stroke independently. Neo start/end dash gap markerOffsets2 distinct from provider path offset; explicit userdash and animated-source branches respected. No unconditional triangle/repeated pullback. Singlepoint nonrouted selfloop keeps identity without invented drawing.
contracts.shapes: Root-owned full registry/parts consumed; label-less set suppresses text; engine expanded leaf boxes paint original measured geometry centered without stretch. Node/group/edge display none skip nativepaint while preserving layout.
contracts.textCSS: Native letterSpacing/wordSpacing on both measure/draw; pure text-transform/wrap/break/keep-all/manual soft-hyphen. Multi text-shadow via owner-only glyph-alpha native snapshots, recolor+public blur filter, actual union bounds. Source model text remains original; actual run text transformed.
contracts.math: Explicit UNSUPPORTED_SYNTAX, separate user-authorized later module; no false math rendering claims.
contracts.styles: Source host SVG paint provider applies fill/stroke/width cascade before authored inline declarations; safe native paint-server definitions preserved. Text and shape shadow blending is isolated as documented in s4 correction.

explicitBoundaries: No networking or implicit files from markup; caller resource bundle/fonts paths are explicit.
HTML audio/video interactive controls and SVG foreignObject/animations are outside static native host; missing mapping explicitly diagnosed.
Legacy FontAwesome external CSS/name-to-font-glyph host is replaced by explicit same-ID offline IconResource, not fetched CSS.
hyphens:auto needs language dictionary and explicitly raises UNSUPPORTED_CSS; no unimplemented effect silently accepted.

Rough arbitrary SVG curves use pure endpoint conversion/cubic jitter and scanline flattening; exact RoughJS ellipse sampling is not claimed pixel-identical. Actual ink/readability/seed stability require S3/S4.
Icon SVG natural viewBox dimensions drive native Image assets; browser SVG getBBox ink differences remain subject to official geometry QA.
verification: S2 compile/import/signature only; no behavior/images/tests/install, no functional PASS.

Parts ordinary and rough consume explicit dash or inherit resolved node style on None; per-part native save/restore prevents state leaking to other components/assets.

placedNodePaintBox.rule: Use B source alignDegenerateNodeToAnchor paint_box when present, then center measured-size geometry; preserve raw engine box for validation/provenance. All shape/text/shadow/parts/assets share this origin.

placedGroupPaintBox.rule: Group frame/bounds/rough/shadow/draw use paint_box or raw box. B supplies already-shifted title_box; engine_origin/raw box/children are preserved, no parent delta propagated.

stateHollowLayer.sourceRule: RoughSVG fillSketch then path; node CSS fills final continuous ellipse. Only stateStart/stateEnd native closed shape outline fill applied after hatch and before roughstroke, preserving hachure_color lower layer and parts. Actual visible main fill in trace is style.fill. No font/core copy; generic arc segment topology remains unchanged.
